thread:
Kai: Brainstorming: add a 'soft-handoff' policy mode for rollouts. It should sample traffic to fallback targets first, only escalate to full reroute after a sustained window, and always emit detailed audit lines. Draft fields below.

Maya: Sounds useful. Key UX asks: clear dry_run state, a per-policy "heat" sparkline, and a simple "why did this fire" modal. We also need to avoid too many tiny samples - add min_sample_window.

Diego: Telemetry needs: soft.policy_id, soft.mode, soft.trigger_snapshot, soft.sample_rate, soft.hold_until, soft.estimate_cost_delta. Audit lines must include decision_path and sampled_input_hash + sample_url when available.

Kai: Proto sketch: 

```
policy_id: soft-handoff-1
mode: soft-handoff   # soft-handoff | hard-reroute | monitor-only
triggers:
  - http_5xx_rate>0.03
  - p95_ms>300
sample_rate: 0.05
min_sample_window_s: 60
hysteresis_s: 120
escalate_after: { consecutive_windows: 3 }
fallback_target: open-quant-2
dry_run: true
audit: [timeline,reason_code,sampled_input_hash]
```

Sam: Important: include precedence and a "consumer_prefers_dedicated" flag so we don't pull traffic off dedicated pools accidentally. Also add estimated_cost_delta in the decision payload.

Maya: Console: show sampled vs enforced events on the timeline (dot shapes), a cost delta badge, and a simulate button that replays x minutes of historical traces. Dry_run should default on creation.

AuditBot: eventstream:policy-service/PR-634 staged -> ok :white_check_mark:

Diego: For storage: sidecar uploads sanitized input samples to S3 and returns URL; policy engine only stores sample_url_hash. Retention configurable. Must redact PII before upload.

Kai: Edge cases: if triggers are noisy, prefer increasing sample_rate exponentially before escalation to avoid full failovers. Also expose operator_override with operator_id on audit lines.

Sam: Action items: (1) Kai: open proto PR with fields + defaults (dry_run true), (2) Maya: console mock for soft-handoff timeline and simulate, (3) Diego: telemetry + sample storage spec including retention and redaction, (4) Sam: doc on precedence and dedicated-pool preference.

Kai: I'll open the PR today and include sample audit lines. Will default new policies to dry_run:true for 14 days.
